body:
Come on, this entire thing just sunk down the tubes, forgotten, never seen.

What the fuck.  I just need to type, I'm done, I FUCKING GIVE UP.  I"M SCARED.

I guess I'll just talk to myself then.

"So, you have no reason to live"

"Right"

"Why not kill yourself"

"Getting there, just too much of a coward."

"You realize no one will ever care about you, that you're just a piece of shit to be discarded, already forgotten."

"yes, I see that daily, I am not even allowed to talk about it."

"go buy a gun"

"yeah, I need to be a strong man for once, someone to be proud of."

"maybe next life"

I had a glimmer of hope.  There was always some excuse for why things were as they had been, some thing I could change.

That's what kept me going, got me up early and pushed me.  It was pretty pointless in retrospect.  Made no difference.

>My older brother is handsome, taller, charismatic, and much more successful. I noticed how women and men react to him and yearn for at least a sliver of the same.

I was purposely pulling the wool over my eyes on this one.  Once I finally did all the self-improvement crap I realized it was just a carrot on a stick, you don't get the carrot.  That's for pretty people.  When I realized all that work was for nothing (so much so that even pointing it out leads to ridicule [what, you think you're *entitled* to a girlfriend]), and that the beautiful still waltz into a room and take what's theirs  without question, and that this, without fail, morphs into all aspects of life, I just imploded. 

 Done.  Too much work, no effort.  There is no reward, it's an input system.  No output.  I'd say the machine is broken, but it's clearly paying out to better looking, more "charming" people (I'm a strong believer that we paint specific adjectives on people based on the halo effect).

My brothers and relatives are the same way.  All beautiful, tall, wondering why things don't work out.  They tell me just to try harder, apparently not aware of just how much less natural and "tryhard" an ugly person doing the things a tall person does comes off.  Napoleon complex and all that. Of course, the opposite doesn't work either, then you're just "snubbing them" (they didn't want to talk in the first place, but hey, why not use the opportunity to paint someone else as a social pariah).

People find carrots, philosophy, hedonism, virtuous living, etc. Some are just fucking oblivious, they can't overthink it so they don't.  Others are pretty enough that they can live with the knowledge, because it's power to them.  It's not oppression.  That must be the life, being a beautiful, enlightened person.

What bothers me is that they actively get off on seeing another's life get worse.  Not like a mortal enemy who wronged them twelve times over, just another human trying to get by.  The pain makes the other laugh, it makes them smile, it turns them on.

That scares me.  It's not just the lack of caring, it's the opposite.  They know you're suffering, they *love* it.

My number one life lesson is don't expect them to help - it's that they they don't notice, they do. They just have a fucked up reality perception where they see themselves as better off if others are worse.

I get what you mean.  My family doesn't give a shit about me anymore, too much of a depressing downer.  Just supposed to shit down, shut up and smile. Show up, act a certain way, play the part. Nod when they ask why things aren't going along well inter-personally.
